nodes.description: Public owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the authorization root and ether withdrawal recipient.
Address of the ERC20 token contract traded by GetToken; fully caller supplied, so every external call made through it targets an arbitrary contract.
Price of one token in wei (szabo-scaled); used as divisor and multiplier in BuyToken and writable by the owner via SetPrice.
External ERC20 interface declaration: totalSupply() returning uint.
External ERC20 interface declaration: balanceOf(address) returning uint; invoked by BuyToken on the stored token address.
External ERC20 interface declaration: transfer(address,uint) returning bool; invoked by WithdrawToken and BuyToken on the stored token address.
External ERC20 interface declaration: transferFrom(address,address,uint) returning bool.
External ERC20 interface declaration: approve(address,uint) returning bool.
External ERC20 interface declaration: allowance(address,address) returning uint.
Owned constructor: assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
Owner-only function that emits OwnershipTransferred and reassigns the owner state variable to newOwner.
Modifier performing the access-control check msg.sender != owner with revert; guards transferOwnership, WithdrawToken, SetPrice and WithdrawEther.
Constructor storing the attacker-controlled token address and computing sellPrice = _sellPrice * 1 szabo without overflow checks.
Owner-only function that performs an external ERC20 transfer of tokens from the contract to the owner.
Owner-only function that sets sellPrice = newprice * 1 szabo with unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only function that sends ether to owner with address.send after a balance check.
Payable purchase routine: derived token count from msg.value/sellPrice, refunds excess ether with send, then transfers tokens to msg.sender.
Payable fallback function that forwards all plain ether transfers to BuyToken().
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment, the onlyOwner authorization check, and as recipient of refunded ether and purchased tokens.
Unchecked multiplication of the constructor argument _sellPrice by 1 szabo, allowing silent integer overflow.
Unchecked multiplication of the SetPrice argument newprice by 1 szabo, allowing silent integer overflow.
Division of msg.value by the stored sellPrice with no zero-guard, reverting or mispricing when sellPrice is zero or attacker-influenced.
Unchecked multiplication of the contract token balance by sellPrice, used to cap accepted ether and computable for overflow.
Unchecked subtraction computing the ether refund owed to the buyer.
External ether transfer to owner via send inside WithdrawEther, giving the recipient execution flow during a state-changing routine.
External ether refund to the untrusted caller via send inside BuyToken, executed before the token transfer to the same caller.
External call into the caller-supplied token contract during WithdrawToken, enabling a malicious token implementation to re-enter the contract.
External call into the caller-supplied token contract during BuyToken, enabling reentrancy while the purchase is still in progress.
External view call into the caller-supplied token contract whose return value drives BuyToken's refund logic.
Parameter of transferOwnership holding the address that becomes the new owner.
Constructor parameter supplying the ERC20 token contract address that is stored in the token state variable.
Constructor parameter used as the base token price before the szabo scaling multiplication.
Parameter of WithdrawToken giving the amount of tokens the owner withdraws.
Parameter of SetPrice carrying the new base price before the szabo multiplication.
Parameter of WithdrawEther giving the amount of wei to send to the owner.
Local computed as msg.value / sellPrice, representing the number of tokens owed to the buyer.
Local holding the contract's token balance as returned by the external balanceOf call.
Local holding the excess ether to be refunded to the buyer.
Local holding the maximum ether accepted for the full token balance (total * sellPrice).
Placeholder aggregating the unimplemented ERC20 interface parameters (addresses and values of balanceOf, transfer, transferFrom, approve and allowance) which carry no logic in this file.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a value-only parameter whose flow terminates in the ownership assignment performed by transferOwnership.
_token is a constructor parameter directly written into the token state variable by the constructor.
_sellPrice is a constructor parameter whose only role is the unchecked price computation inside the constructor.
tokens is the withdrawal amount parameter consumed directly by WithdrawToken's external transfer.
newprice is solely used by SetPrice to recompute sellPrice.
ethers is the send amount parameter used only inside WithdrawEther.
The tokens local is computed and immediately consumed by the outbound token transfer to the buyer.
The total local is only the external balanceOf result used to compute maxethers.
The change local exists only to carry the refund amount into msg.sender.send.
The maxethers local is the direct product of total and sellPrice used for the ether ceiling.
The aggregated ERC20 interface parameters carry no executable logic and are only meaningful as argument shapes of the external transfer/balanceOf calls.
